market_outlook.short_term: Bullish but fragile. Nasdaq at highs, S&P best day since August, earnings upgrades support momentum. However, 145-year warning signal, Fed hawkishness, and oil volatility create 5-10% correction risk within 60 days. Tech leadership may broaden to semiconductors and AI infrastructure. Watch for Fed speakers and Iran deal progress as swing factors.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive with caution. AI capex cycle (Alibaba, Applied Materials, Novo Nordisk) supports 12-18 month earnings growth. Dividend momentum and earnings upgrade cycle suggest corporate confidence. However, global growth cooling (UK, Euro, France), political risk, and potential Fed tightening cap upside. Expect 8-12% equity gains with 10-15% drawdown risk. Crypto regulatory clarity and tokenization could add 15-20% to digital asset allocations.
